newFeatures.targetStory: As a parent, I can receive chore notifications in an MCP Events-capable client.
newFeatures.targetNotes: Authenticated MCP clients receive the same new notifications as Telegram through webhook-only draft events/list, events/subscribe and events/unsubscribe under chores.notification. Verified HTTPS receivers use client-supplied Standard Webhooks secrets. Subscriptions are isolated by authenticated principal and URL, expire after a negotiated one-minute to one-day grant, and retain signed independent retries in Redis. Payloads preserve the exact notification text and stable ID. The journal is committed atomically with the domain change, independent of Telegram, with up to 5,000 events from seven days for replay. Clients refresh before expiry, retain safe cursors, deduplicate eventId and inspect authoritative state after truncated or gap. Public polling and SSE Events delivery are not current behavior; kid cookies never grant event access. Missing subscriptions return NotFound; subscription/verification limits return ResourceExhausted. Every integer TTL suggestion clamps to the advertised grant range. Initial maxAgeMs applies across the full replay regardless of commit/timestamp ordering.

confirmedDecisions.choreSpeech: Removed: the kids can read their chores; no Hear it control or speech endpoint.
confirmedDecisions.namedWindows: Pacific windows are Morning 7am–7:30am, Before lunch 7:30am–noon, Afternoon noon–5pm, Evening 5pm–8:15pm, and Night 8:15pm–10pm, with exclusive closing boundaries. No visible moon or text appears; webpage blackout does not change the hardware backlight.
confirmedDecisions.quietAllClear: Outstanding chores keep colorful raised columns, a solid card, emoji, and action button. A deployment-version change or missing/non-JSON/malformed API response triggers a guarded document reload, at most once per five minutes per tab. Automatic reload waits for all busy or uncertain saves to resolve so their exact retry IDs survive. Network failures retry data and show a friendly reconnecting message.

notCurrentBehaviors.title: Other-day chore browsing
notCurrentBehaviors.notBehavior: Navigating dates must not display past/future chore lists or their completion controls.
notCurrentBehaviors.currentBehavior: Daily history is counts-only; the actionable board stays on today and the current period.

notCurrentBehaviors.title: Opening other time groups
notCurrentBehaviors.notBehavior: Expanding/collapsing other named groups, keeping them open manually, and group recollapse timers are not current behavior.
notCurrentBehaviors.currentBehavior: Only the current named period and eligible untimed Bonus chores are reachable.

notCurrentBehaviors.title: Overlapping Evening and Night
notCurrentBehaviors.notBehavior: The old 7pm Night opening and simultaneous Evening/Night display are not current behavior.
notCurrentBehaviors.currentBehavior: Evening ends and Night begins at 8:15pm Pacific; all named windows are non-overlapping.

notCurrentBehaviors.title: Late or backdated completions
notCurrentBehaviors.notBehavior: Neither kids nor parents can create an early, previous-day, or elapsed-window completion/request, including through an approval escape hatch.
notCurrentBehaviors.currentBehavior: An actually accepted on-time submission can be approved later without reopening its old chore.

notCurrentBehaviors.title: Automatic overdue one-off carryover
notCurrentBehaviors.notBehavior: An unfinished one-off does not remain completable indefinitely after its scheduled date or window.
notCurrentBehaviors.currentBehavior: A parent can explicitly reschedule current/future work without inventing past credit.

notCurrentBehaviors.title: Skipping and skip credit
notCurrentBehaviors.notBehavior: Skip, skip confirmation/cancellation, per-kid skip/unskip, skipped progress, skipped bonus credit, and skip notifications are not current behavior for kids or parents.
notCurrentBehaviors.currentBehavior: Parents may mute through scheduling; this excludes requirements without completing them or awarding chore stars.

notCurrentBehaviors.title: Automatic chore sorting
notCurrentBehaviors.notBehavior: Sorting chores by type, newest-first creation order, title, stars, or model priority is not current behavior.
notCurrentBehaviors.currentBehavior: Use the saved parent-specified sequence; filtering and temporary choice do not reorder it.

notCurrentBehaviors.title: Extra ten-star daily award
notCurrentBehaviors.notBehavior: The +10 full-day bonus, its target/progress offer, celebration dialog, and new notification are not current behavior.
notCurrentBehaviors.currentBehavior: Exactly +2 per completed nonempty named period replaces it. Preserve historical credits already recorded.

notCurrentBehaviors.title: Empty-period or Bonus-period payout
notCurrentBehaviors.notBehavior: An empty period or untimed Bonus list does not earn a period-completion payout.
notCurrentBehaviors.currentBehavior: A named period must have at least one remaining required task; pending work must first be approved.

notCurrentBehaviors.title: Hidden work still required
notCurrentBehaviors.notBehavior: A parent-hidden chore must not remain in the period target just because its window opened or it has pending/undone history.
notCurrentBehaviors.currentBehavior: Exclude it immediately while preserving history. Completed remaining nonempty periods can earn +2. Unmuted missed work is still missed.

notCurrentBehaviors.title: Automatic Bonus assignment
notCurrentBehaviors.notBehavior: Finishing required chores must not automatically assign an untimed Bonus chore as the next obligation.
notCurrentBehaviors.currentBehavior: Bonus is an optional explicit choice available anytime.

notCurrentBehaviors.title: Indistinguishable all-clear and active cards
notCurrentBehaviors.notBehavior: Finished/empty columns must not look like outstanding chore cards; pending approval, failure, or loading must not be presented as completed work.
notCurrentBehaviors.currentBehavior: Use subdued finished/empty/pending states and colorful outstanding cards. Only a confirmed current all-clear invites Go play.

notCurrentBehaviors.title: Dedicated Choose another button
notCurrentBehaviors.notBehavior: A separate Choose another button is not current behavior.
notCurrentBehaviors.currentBehavior: Tap the Finish this {timeframe} period card to open the chore picker.

notCurrentBehaviors.title: Duplicate completion count
notCurrentBehaviors.notBehavior: A second 0 of N done line directly beneath the card repeating its progress is not current behavior.
notCurrentBehaviors.currentBehavior: Keep progress inside the period card.

notCurrentBehaviors.title: Chore-title read-aloud
notCurrentBehaviors.notBehavior: Hear it, open/completed-title speech, and the chore speech endpoint are not current behavior.
notCurrentBehaviors.currentBehavior: The kids read their chores; completion and redemption sound effects remain.

notCurrentBehaviors.title: Daytime blackout or visible sleep decoration
notCurrentBehaviors.notBehavior: All-day five-minute blackout and a visible moon/text on the black screen are not current behavior.
notCurrentBehaviors.currentBehavior: Only 8:30pm–6am San Francisco time permits the pure-black idle screen; it clears at 6am. This does not control iPad hardware brightness.

notCurrentBehaviors.title: Dedicated parent interface
notCurrentBehaviors.notBehavior: Parent dashboards, forms/settings pages, PIN gates, approval/undo pages, and a dedicated parent packing/setup portal are not current behavior.
notCurrentBehaviors.currentBehavior: Parents talk to ChatGPT using authenticated current MCP/CLI tools; they can still look at the shared kid display.

notCurrentBehaviors.title: Clippy or Telegram management
